brief:
Gaza held a ceremony honouring Al Jazeera journalists Anas al-Sharif and Mohammed Qraiqea, according to Al Jazeera English. The exact details of the event and the reasons for the honour were not specified in initial reporting.

The recognition comes as international journalists continue coverage of developments in Gaza. Al Jazeera has maintained a reporting presence in the territory despite operational challenges faced by media organizations working there.
dek: Gaza honours Al Jazeera’s Anas al-Sharif and Mohammed Qraiqea.
title: Gaza honours Al Jazeera journalists Sharif and Qraiqea
